1976-4659-5224-6294.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {1} due to Etherium Sculptor, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-5700-5701-6763-8337.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5700-5701-6763-8337.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and M'Ress trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, M'Ress triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, M'Ress triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2393-4279-7192--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2393-4279-7192--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations, Sifter of Skulls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1339-1832-4050-6094.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-4050-6094.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color
When the Insect dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

3899-4694-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
3899-4694-4802-7306.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

728-4871-5220-5849.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
728-4871-5220-5849.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1170-5131-6797-7693--202.easyPrerequisites:
Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6797-7693--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Armor Wars.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

2097-7839-7926.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature or artifact.
Your commander is on the battlefield.
2097-7839-7926.description:
Activate Slag Strider by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens due to Jolene.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

489-1090-2146-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

2642-4050-7515.description:
Cast a copy of Scrollboost by paying {1}{W}.
Dovescape triggers, countering Scrollboost and causing you to create two 1/1 flying Bird creature tokens.
When the tokens enter, Spiritcall Enthusiast triggers, becoming prepared.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Bird tokens, adding {W}{W}.
Repeat.

2034-6705-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-6705-7306.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Quina.
Activate the Mutagen token by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature token.
Repeat.

4217-6556-7302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
4217-6556-7302.description:
Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Temur Battlecrier.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Lutri.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Land with Cycling Cost that can be paid using one colored mana

65-2546-2628-7206--38.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more creatures.
65-2546-2628-7206--38.description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {0} due to Fluctuator and discarding it.
When you cycle the land, Escape Protocol and Surly Badgersaur trigger.
Resolve Surly Badgersaur's ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding (1).
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability, paying {1} to blink Dundoolin Weaver.
When Dundoolin Weaver enters, it triggers, returning the cycled land from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, drawing a card.
65-2546-2628-7206--38.notes: Since you can draw your entire library, discarding down to maximum hand size at end of turn will trigger Surly Badgersaur's abilities many times.

4050-5170-6132-6273.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

549-1365-2131-4853-7098.notablePrerequisites:
You control two additional nontoken creatures, one of which has another card type besides artifact or creature.
The additional nontoken creatures have base toughness 2 or greater and do not have a -1/-1 counter on them.
549-1365-2131-4853-7098.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the additional creatures persist until end of turn.
Activate Baba Lysaga by tapping it and sacrificing the two additional creatures.
When the creatures die, Dross Scorpion triggers twice and the creatures' persist abilities each trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Baba Lysaga and Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the first persist creature, returning one of the creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature enters, Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining persist trigger.
Resolve the Baba Lysaga ability from step 2, causing you to gain 3 life, each opponent to lose 3 life, and you to draw three cards.
Repeat.

967-1308-2438-3809-7087.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

141-3440-4050.description:
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Demonic Gifts, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Demonic Gifts.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

628-6798-6935.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

338-4321-5641-6890.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-4321-5641-6890.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4375-5400.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Synth Infiltrator enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Synth Infiltrator.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

3305-3817-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing Body Launderer to connive.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat.

5080-6464.description:
Cast Maddening Cacophony with kicker by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each opponent to mill half their library, rounded up.
Activate Keening Stone by paying {5} and tapping it, causing an opponent to mill cards equal to the number of cards in their graveyard, thus milling the rest of their library.

1-1786-5435-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-1786-5435-6282.description:
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dream Trawler ability.
Repeat.

643-1789-2921-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

801-4314-5173-5626.notablePrerequisites: One of Impulsive Pilferer or Shambling Ghast must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard.
801-4314-5173-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer or Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Impulsive Pilferer or Shambling Ghast dies, it and Pawn of Ulamog trigger.
Resolve the Impulsive Pilferer or Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning either Impulsive Pilferer or Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2060-2577-3602-5686.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
2060-2577-3602-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

859-1424-1818.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Lurking Roper.
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
859-1424-1818.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
When the Elf Warrior enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain two life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
